title: OMG SysML v2.0 Language manual visual ledger: Annex A.4-A.13

source.title: OMG Systems Modeling Language (SysML) Version 2.0, Part 1: Language Specification

scope.notes: A.3 Vehicle is recorded in annex_a_3_vehicle_definition.json. This ledger records every additional closed source panel and every visually identified incomplete/placeholder panel in A.4-A.13.

review_method: Rendered physical pages 670-691 were visually inspected. PDF text extraction was used only for navigation and token cross-checking; rendered layout determined source-panel boundaries, page continuations, visible comments, and literal omission markers.

status_vocabulary.complete: A closed SysML source panel suitable for a repository-owned parser fixture.
status_vocabulary.incomplete_placeholder: The official panel contains a literal ellipsis, an unclosed excerpt, or otherwise omits source that cannot be invented.
status_vocabulary.figure_source_discrepancy: The source panel is retained as evidence but visibly differs from the accompanying figure; no correction is applied.
